title: 第2329章 曾是武神第2328章 曾经的师徒
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 众人都看了出来，这是想要重新招揽白帝啊。
“恐怕不只是招揽这么简单。”
一位老者目光闪动了一下，沉声说道：“他这是想要重新建立师徒关系，想来他是占据了这具身体，却无法在短时间内恢复至巅峰，知道走出冥渊之后，想要在南域立足，就需要帮手。”
“好深的算计……”
众人倒吸一口凉气。
被自己的徒弟背叛封印了这么多年，不仅不杀了他徒弟，反而大方地想要重新收下对方，这份心机，他们自认为做不到。
然而，白帝能背刺过他一次，就不怕背刺他第二次吗？
就算他们不认同他的做法，但是也不得不承认此人之前绝对是一位枭雄，就是不知道他原来的真实身份。
然而，白帝看着向他伸过来的手，沉默了片刻后说道：“你认为我还会答应你吗？你不过是想要再利用我，榨干我最后的价值。”
“姜玄烨”看着白帝，一字一句地说道：“如果没有我，你终究会消散，这世上除了成仙，就没有所谓的永生。”
“你修炼的这门功法，在传给你的时候，记得就告诉过，此功法一旦修炼，每隔一段时间，就会在体内新生一道神魂，与你抢夺身体。”
“我也没有想到这么多年，你居然能将那些新生的神魂压制，但你没有办法将他们完全消灭。”
“你要是不能解决这些神魂，你一旦镇压不住，他们就会将你的神魂生生撕碎，你终将会永远消失。”
白帝再次沉默了。
而那些围观的武修们在听到“姜玄烨”的话，皆都露出震惊神色，这世上居然还有这样的功法。
虽说这门功法并不能做到真正的永生，但是对于那些要死的人来说，即便变成人不人，鬼不鬼的样子，他们也无所谓。
更何况，肉身还保持这么完美，与活人并没有多大的区别。
“其实这么多年，我也早就活腻了。”
白帝终于开口了。
“好一个活腻了，看来曾经意气风发的好徒儿，如今却是想要死了，看来还是为师对你的伤害太大了，倒让为师心中感觉到惭愧了。”
“姜玄烨”嘴上虽然这样说，但是脸上哪有半点惭愧的样子。
白帝冷笑一声：“惭愧？你这样的人，连心都没有，怎会有惭愧？如果真感觉惭愧，不如自我了断，我便叫你一声师父，如何？”
“姜玄烨”闻言，面色不变，好似并没有生气，反而轻笑了一声，叹息道：“是啊，为师连心都没有，又怎么会感觉到惭愧了。”
“什么连心都没有？”
围观的武修皆都一脸懵，不知道他们在说什么。
有武修皱眉道：“或许这位前辈只剩下了神魂，连肉身都没有，自然就没有心了。”
众人听到了这个解释，虽然感觉哪里不对，但是又说不上哪里不对，他们总感觉并不是那么简单。
content_en:
Everyone could see that he was trying to recruit Bai Di again.
"I'm afraid it's not just as simple as recruiting."
An old man's eyes flashed and he said in a deep voice: "He wants to re-establish the master-disciple relationship. It seems that he has taken over this body, but he can't recover to the peak in a short time. He knows that after walking out of the abyss, if he wants to gain a foothold in the Southern Territory, he will need help."
"What a profound calculation..."
Everyone gasped.
Having been betrayed and sealed by his apprentice for so many years, not only did he not kill his apprentice, but he generously wanted to accept him again, a scheming they thought they couldn't do.
However, if Bai Di could backstab him once, wouldn't he be afraid of backstabbing him a second time?
Even if they don't agree with his actions, they still have to admit that this person was definitely a hero before, but they just didn't know his true identity.
However, Bai Di looked at the hand stretched out to him and said after a moment of silence: "Do you think I will still agree to you? You just want to use me again and squeeze out the last of my value."
"Jiang Xuanye" looked at Bai Emperor and said word by word: "Without me, you will eventually dissipate. Apart from becoming an immortal, there is no so-called eternal life in this world."
"When the technique you practiced was passed on to you, I remember telling you that once you practice this technique, every once in a while, a soul will be born in your body and compete with you for your body."
"I didn't expect that after so many years, you could actually suppress those new souls, but you can't completely eliminate them."
"If you can't deal with these souls, once you can't suppress them, they will tear your soul into pieces, and you will disappear forever."
Bai Di was silent again.
When the martial arts cultivators who were watching heard what "Jiang Xuanye" said, they all looked shocked. There was actually such a technique in this world.
Although this technique cannot achieve true immortality, for those who are about to die, it does not matter to them even if they become human or ghost.
What's more, the physical body remains so perfect, not much different from a living person.
"Actually, after so many years, I have long been tired of living."
Bai Di finally spoke.
"You are tired of living. It seems that your once good and high-spirited disciple now wants to die. It seems that I have hurt you too much, which makes me feel ashamed."
"Jiang Xuanye" Although he said this, there was no look of shame on his face.
Bai Di sneered: "Ashamed? How can a person like you be ashamed if you don't even have a heart? If you really feel ashamed, why not kill yourself? How about I call you Master?"
When "Jiang Xuanye" heard this, his expression remained unchanged, as if he was not angry. Instead, he chuckled lightly and sighed: "Yes, I don't even have a heart, so how can I feel ashamed?"
"What's the point of not even having a heart?"
The martial arts cultivators who were watching were all confused, not knowing what they were talking about.
A martial artist frowned and said, "Perhaps this senior only has his soul left, not even his body, so naturally he has no heart."
After everyone heard this explanation, although they felt something was wrong, they couldn't say what was wrong. They always felt that it was not that simple.
